recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It directly applies the published seed decision in the authoritative current source; FHIR-46200 can later be audited as satisfied by this same source state if that issue enters an Applied/Published reconciliation scope.
issue_request: FHIR-28307 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction requesting that the misleading note in ElementDefinition.comment's Definition text be moved down to ElementDefinition.comment's Comment text, with note-ending periods placed inside the parentheses.
initial_application: The note wording was originally introduced by FHIR-16995/GForge 16995 in commit 0a3cfa673c. No FHIR-28307-tagged source commit was found, and the current active ElementDefinition spreadsheet still had the ElementDefinition.comment note in the definition cell before this reconciliation.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2020-12-07 recorded FHIR-28307 as 'Will fix as suggested' and a Technical Correction. A 2024 Zulip discussion and FHIR-46200 later identified the same remaining note problem, but FHIR-46200 is only Resolved - change required in this default run; FHIR-46201 concerns separate profiling.html MustSupport text and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Edited source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml, an active ElementDefinition datatype source referenced by source/fhir.ini, so the ElementDefinition.comment note is now in the comment cell while ElementDefinition.comment's definition cell contains only the explanatory definition.
source_changes: source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: moved the ElementDefinition.comment parenthetical note from the Definition cell to the Comment cell.
source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: placed the final period inside both ElementDefinition.definition and ElementDefinition.comment parenthetical notes.
